description: Pauses an installation so its package setup and scheduled package work stop. Requires agency write access to the client or the client owner, and the current revision. It does not delete anything; use retry to queue it again.

expectedRevision.description: The installation revision you last read. The call is rejected if the installation has changed since.

installationId.description: The agency package installation to act on.

name: agency_installation_pause
title: Pause Installation
